name: Cardiovascular Disease Qualifying Admissions
description: Beneficiary-admission file containing MedPAR inpatient admissions that meet the cvd__icdcodeset001__dx10__all_admissions outcome definition. Rows identify included beneficiaries/admissions with the condition for the configured diagnosis-position and admissions-criteria rule.

content.outcome: String: Outcome condition assigned to the qualifying admission
content.age_65plus_ind: Int32: Age 65 or older indicator; 1 = age 65 or older, 0 = under age 65
content.ffs_ind: Int32: Fee-for-Service eligibility indicator; 1 = Fee-for-Service eligible, 0 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage/HMO
